elsewhere:azmar_survey_map_filled: The unfolded Azmar Survey Map: use a Azmar Survey Map (sold in Azmar's shop) to turn it into this explorer-style map, centred on the nearest Azmar castle with a red X.
elsewhere:chiseled_sunwright_bricks: Chiseled Sunwright Bricks: the carved stone of the Sunwright Ziggurat in the Glasswaste. Mine it with a pickaxe; it drops itself.
elsewhere:choir_pillar: One of the 8 crystal pillars of the Choir Geode (The Hush). Strike all 8 once each to summon Lithara, the Geode Cantor.
An arena fixture: it is part of the structure and drops nothing when broken, so it cannot be collected in survival.
elsewhere:drowned_organ: The playable organ in the nave of the Drowned Cathedral (The Verdigris Sea, Foundry Trench). Archdeacon Verdigrim answers its music.
An arena fixture: it is part of the structure and drops nothing when broken, so it cannot be collected in survival.
elsewhere:duel_block: A temporary block a kingdom duelist raises during a fight. It cracks and vanishes after 30 s, when its owner falls, or when its chunk unloads, and is never placed so that it walls a player in.
An arena fixture: it is part of the structure and drops nothing when broken, so it cannot be collected in survival.
elsewhere:frostgranite: Frostgranite: the stone of Ironpeak's high slopes. Mine it with a pickaxe (it drops itself); stonecut or craft it into slabs, stairs, walls, polished stone and bricks.
elsewhere:gilded_throne: The gilded throne of Grunthar's hoard (the Nether). Place a gold block on the throne to summon Grunthar & Ashtusk.
Breaking it with the right tool drops the block itself, so you can take it home as a trophy or for building.
elsewhere:gulpmother_frogspawn: Frogspawn around the lily-pad pool of the Croaking Shrine, Old Gulpmother's home in mangrove swamps.
An arena fixture: it is part of the structure and drops nothing when broken, so it cannot be collected in survival.
elsewhere:gulpmother_shrine_cauldron: The cauldron of the Croaking Shrine (mangrove swamps). Drop 3 slimeballs into it at night to summon Old Gulpmother.
An arena fixture: it is part of the structure and drops nothing when broken, so it cannot be collected in survival.
elsewhere:halo_altar: The spire altar of the Shattered Halo (The End). Place the dragon egg on it with 4 end crystals to summon Aphelion; you get the egg back.
Breaking it with the right tool drops the block itself, so you can take it home as a trophy or for building.
elsewhere:heartwood_log: The living heartwood of the Elder Trunk in the Pale Hollow, where Mother Creak sleeps. It drops nothing; Pale Hollow trees give pale oak instead.
An arena fixture: it is part of the structure and drops nothing when broken, so it cannot be collected in survival.
elsewhere:hotbox_vent: A vent shutter of the Great Hotbox (The Greenhaze), the smoke-filled dome of Percolax. In his second phase the vents slam shut and the smoke builds up; the lever beside a shutter opens it again.
An arena fixture: it is part of the structure and drops nothing when broken, so it cannot be collected in survival.
elsewhere:hrafnholt_survey_map_filled: The unfolded Hrafnholt Survey Map: use a Hrafnholt Survey Map (sold in Hrafnholt's shop) to turn it into this explorer-style map, centred on the nearest Hrafnholt castle with a red X.
elsewhere:kelpwood_log: Kelpwood: the trees of the Verdigris Sea islands. Chop the log with an axe; 1 log makes 4 Kelpwood Planks.
elsewhere:kushwood_leaves: Leaves of the Kushwood trees in the Greenhaze. Shears collect them; otherwise they drop sticks.
elsewhere:kushwood_log: Kushwood: the trees of the Greenhaze. Chop the log with an axe; 1 log makes 4 Kushwood Planks.
elsewhere:lore_royal_survey_map_filled: The unfolded Royal Survey Map: use a folded Royal Survey Map (3 Survey Map Fragments) in the Overworld and it turns into this explorer-style map, centred on the nearest Castle Aldermark with a red X.
elsewhere:matriarch_pedestal: The dragon-egg pedestal on top of the Matriarch Spire (The End). Place a shulker shell on it, with the Ender Dragon dead, to summon Ossyra.
Breaking it with the right tool drops the block itself, so you can take it home as a trophy or for building.
elsewhere:mirewick_survey_map_filled: The unfolded Mirewick Survey Map: use a Mirewick Survey Map (sold in Mirewick's shop) to turn it into this explorer-style map, centred on the nearest Mirewick castle with a red X.
elsewhere:moon_bloom: The single closed eyeblossom in the center of the Moonring (Pale Hollow). Pick it to summon Selenne, the Unblinking.
An arena fixture: it is part of the structure and drops nothing when broken, so it cannot be collected in survival.
elsewhere:moonring_stone: A tuff monolith of the Moonring in the Pale Hollow: 12 of them circle the eyeblossom meadow where Selenne is summoned.
An arena fixture: it is part of the structure and drops nothing when broken, so it cannot be collected in survival.
elsewhere:music_disc_four_twenty: A music disc: Four Twenty. The Greenhaze Budtender trades it for a Grumblegut Tusk.
elsewhere:music_disc_hush: A music disc: Hush. The Mute Archivist of the Hush trades it for a Cantor's Bell Shard.
elsewhere:music_disc_low_tide_engine: A music disc: Low Tide Engine. The Tidewright of the Verdigris Sea trades it for 4 Scraped Patina.
elsewhere:music_disc_thin_air: A music disc: Thin Air. The Ironpeak Clan Quartermaster trades it for 8 Skyiron and 16 emeralds.
elsewhere:neferkhet_sun_altar: The altar of the Sun Chamber, a hidden hall under desert pyramids. Place a gold block on it at noon to summon Neferkhet, the Sand-Bound King.
An arena fixture: it is part of the structure and drops nothing when broken, so it cannot be collected in survival.
elsewhere:neferkhet_sun_idol: A sun idol of the Sun Chamber, the hidden hall under desert pyramids where Neferkhet sleeps.
An arena fixture: it is part of the structure and drops nothing when broken, so it cannot be collected in survival.
elsewhere:proving_challenge_horn: The challenge horn of the Proving Grounds in Ironpeak. Sound it to call Hrolf Grimhorn; beating him opens the way to Thurgrim on the Summit Throne.
An arena fixture: it is part of the structure and drops nothing when broken, so it cannot be collected in survival.
elsewhere:pyre_cradle_core: The core of the Pyre Cradle, the Nether fortress chamber of Solaxis. Break all 4 blaze spawners in the fortress to summon Solaxis.
Breaking it with the right tool drops the block itself, so you can take it home as a trophy or for building.
elsewhere:resin_heart: The amber heart of the Elder Trunk in the Pale Hollow, Mother Creak's hollow pale-oak column.
An arena fixture: it is part of the structure and drops nothing when broken, so it cannot be collected in survival.
elsewhere:skyblossom_leaves: Leaves of the Skyblossom trees in Petalwind. Shears collect them; they can also drop Skyblossom Saplings.
elsewhere:skyblossom_log: Skyblossom: the blossom trees of Petalwind. Chop the log with an axe; 1 log makes 4 Skyblossom Planks.
elsewhere:skyblossom_sapling: Dropped by Skyblossom leaves in Petalwind. Plant it on dirt or grass and it grows into a Skyblossom tree.
elsewhere:stripped_kelpwood_log: Use an axe on a Kelpwood Log (Verdigris Sea) to strip it.
elsewhere:stripped_kelpwood_wood: Use an axe on Kelpwood Wood (Verdigris Sea) to strip it.
elsewhere:stripped_kushwood_log: Use an axe on a Kushwood Log (Greenhaze) to strip it.
elsewhere:stripped_kushwood_wood: Use an axe on Kushwood Wood (Greenhaze) to strip it.
elsewhere:stripped_skyblossom_log: Use an axe on a Skyblossom Log (Petalwind) to strip it.
elsewhere:stripped_skyblossom_wood: Use an axe on Skyblossom Wood (Petalwind) to strip it.
elsewhere:strong_glimmer_tonic: A stronger Glimmer Tonic: brew a Glimmer Tonic with glowstone dust. Drinking it restores more Glimmer than the plain tonic.
elsewhere:summit_war_drum: The war drum on the Summit Throne in Ironpeak (about Y 1450). Beat it after defeating Hrolf Grimhorn at the Proving Grounds to summon Thurgrim Ironjaw.
Breaking it with the right tool drops the block itself, so you can take it home as a trophy or for building.
elsewhere:tympanum_membrane: The membrane of the Listening Engine (The Hush), the ear-shaped deepslate funnel where Auris answers when your Resonance reaches 100%.
An arena fixture: it is part of the structure and drops nothing when broken, so it cannot be collected in survival.
elsewhere:vent_lever: A vent lever of the Great Hotbox (The Greenhaze). When Percolax slams the vents shut, hold use on a lever for 2 s to open its vent and let the smoke out.
An arena fixture: it is part of the structure and drops nothing when broken, so it cannot be collected in survival.
elsewhere:verdigris_grating: A copper grating from the drowned foundries of the Verdigris Sea (Engineer's Atoll, the Clockwork Rig). Mine it with a pickaxe; it drops itself.
elsewhere:verdigris_pipe: A copper pipe from the drowned foundries of the Verdigris Sea (Engineer's Atoll, the Clockwork Rig). Mine it with a pickaxe; it drops itself.
elsewhere:verdigris_pipe_junction: A copper pipe junction from the drowned foundries of the Verdigris Sea (Engineer's Atoll, the Clockwork Rig). Mine it with a pickaxe; it drops itself.
elsewhere:vorlagh_capstan: The capstan on the deck of the Wreck Ring, three shipwrecks lashed together in deep ocean. Blow a Siren Conch on the deck during a thunderstorm to summon Vorlagh, the Tidewrack Kraken.
An arena fixture: it is part of the structure and drops nothing when broken, so it cannot be collected in survival.
